title: NO FROZEN DEATH IN SUPERHOT
why: His note of 2026-10-25 (played on 33.17 with Superhot on, still true on 34.85): weird noise lingering. With Superhot on and no input held the world stops, and a dead man holds no input, so the death beat counted down by nothing: the screen held on its first frame, the outcome card never came and the room tone stayed under the death duck until he pressed something. Now the death beat keeps its own clock on real frames, so it ends in its second and a half and the card comes up with or without input. Solo, time moves under it as if he acts. In two players the beat ends the same, but a dead player never moves the shared world.
now: With Superhot on, a death no longer freezes until you press something: the death beat plays out and the card comes up on its own. Watch for: in Superhot the world now moves slowly under the death fade, as it does with Superhot off.
